definitions.short: properly, to plait together , i.e. (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate)
definitions.full: H3527. kabar I. [ כָּבַר ] verb be much, many (Assyrian kabâru , be great, mighty ; kabru , great, huge ; Arabic be great , in body, rank, or age, great, noble, aged ; Ethiopic be honoured, magnified ; honoured, glorious ; Sabean epithet כבר Hal Et. Sab. JAs Dec. 1874, No. 90 ; Syriac , for Hebrew הִרְבָּה רָבָה, , (rare) much ; Zinjirli be abundant, numerous ) — Hiph`il (only Elihu) make many , Job 35:16 יַכְבִּר מִלִּין דַעַת בִּבְלִי (compare אֲמָרָיו וְיֶרֶב 34:37 ) > make great , Bu Beitr. 138 , comparing 8:2 ; מַכְבִּיר with the force of a substantive (Ew § 160 c ) 36:31 אכל יתן לְמַכְֶבִּיר giveth food in abundance (= prose לָרֹב , e.g. 2Chr 11:23 ).
